Nina: Rolling q6b-int4 to canary for model-bridge tests. Initial eval shows a weird spike in longtail hallucinations on promptset X2 (multi-turn how-to). Suspect seedbank ordering change from yesterday's merge.
Omar: Can you share a concrete example and the metric delta? small numbers may be noise.
Nina: Example (redacted):
```
User: How do I set up ...
Gold: Step-by-step with exact flags
q6b-int4: Gives steps but invents a CLI flag --fast-sync
q6b-int8: matches gold
```
Lena: Metrics: vs int8 baseline on promptset X2: ROUGE-L -1.9, ExactMatch -2.6%, hallucination rate +0.11. Failures concentrate on multi-turns with repeated entity mentions.
Omar: Could be dedupe/golden mismatch. We did a seedbank shuffle last night that changed anchor ids; microgolden alignment can break. Suggest a 120-sample microgolden audit + fuzzy dedupe pass.
Nina: I'll generate sample ids and run fuzzy dedupe at 0.80. Command: `python scripts/dedupe_seedbank.py --t 0.80 --in promptset_X2.json --out audit_ids_1788888765.json`
label-bot: Created LR-721 "microgolden audit: q6b-int4 X2" 120 items, priority: high.
Lena: Also run quick kernel ablation: int4 with legacy attention path vs new tiling. If legacy path matches int8, it's likely a numeric kernel issue.
test-bot: Canary route created: requests with turns>3 and tokens>400 -> int8-fallback at 1788888877.
Nina: Uploading audit_ids and initial diffs: https://internal/reports/audit_ids_1788888765.json. Kicking off relabel and ablation now. Will post results within 6h.
Omar: If relabel shows alignment, prioritize a small golden refresh and update provenance for the affected anchors. If not, open runtime kernel rollback ticket.
Lena: Thanks — appreciate the quick loop. :white_check_mark:
